description: Executable sealed research adapter for an operator-controlled configuration of the pinned public SynthID Text scoring formulas; not vendor production detection.

golden_conformance.scope: public synthetic token-ID hashing, repetition/EOS masking, mean, weighted-mean, and character-attribution semantics

required_configuration.generation_parameters: temperature, top-k, apply-top-k, num-leaves, and first-ngram behavior
required_configuration.secret_binding: owner-only private binding output created by the sealer
required_configuration.text_serialization: decode without skipping special tokens or cleaning spaces, then UTF-8 text is re-tokenized
required_configuration.supported_effective_length_interval: one closed interval per detector identity
required_configuration.weights: empty for mean; exact public vector for weighted_mean
